Subject: Zoology
Type: Options question. One or more options may be correct.

Question:
Which of the following pairs of hormones are not antagonistic (having opposite effects) to each other?
(A) Parathormone – Calcitonin
(B) Insulin - Glucagon
(C) Aldosterone Atrial Natriuretic Factor
(D) Relaxin - Inhibin

content: {"working":"Parathormone raises Ca2+ while calcitonin lowers it → antagonistic. Insulin lowers blood glucose, glucagon raises it → antagonistic. Aldosterone promotes Na+ retention, ANF promotes Na+ excretion → antagonistic. Relaxin (pregnancy‑related tissue remodeling) and inhibin (inhibits FSH) have unrelated actions, not opposite → not antagonistic.","value":"D","letters":["D"],"blocker":null,"confidence":0.99}
